This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up

- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt

- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start

- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context

- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52

              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

129	### 4.2 宿主构造：多线程 runtime 与 enter() 守卫内的 PegaEngine
130	
131	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
132	
133	`OffloadHost::new` 的前半段做两件事：建 runtime、建 PegaEngine。第二件事有一个不显眼但致命的时序要求——**PegaEngine 必须在 runtime.enter() 守卫内构建**。
134	
135	原因：pegaflow 的 `MetaServerClient`（P2P 模式下负责向 MetaServer 注册块哈希的客户端）在**构造时**就用 `tokio::spawn` 启动后台注册循环。而 `tokio::spawn` 只在「当前线程处于某个 runtime 上下文」时才能调用。`OffloadHost::new` 是一个普通同步函数，跑在调用方的线程上——此刻 runtime 刚建好，但这个线程并没有「进入」它。若直接构造 PegaEngine，`MetaServerClient` 内部的 `tokio::spawn` 会 panic（找不到当前 runtime）。`runtime.enter()` 的守卫把这个线程临时登记进 runtime，让构造期间的 spawn 全部落到**我们自己的** runtime 上。
136	
137	注意一个容易混淆的点：**不开 P2P 也需要 enter()**。守卫包住的是 `PegaEngine::new_with_config` 整体，与 `config.p2p` 是否为 `Some` 无关——源码注释只以 MetaServerClient 为例说明动机，但守卫对两条路径统一生效，这也让代码无需为 P2P 与非 P2P 维护两套构建方式。

249	### 4.3 P2P serving 启动路径：三个 fail-fast 与 ready channel
250	
251	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
252	
253	P2P 模式（`config.p2p = Some`）意味着本实例加入跨实例共享网格：把存的块哈希注册到 MetaServer、在 `advertise_addr` 上服务对端的 RDMA 握手与块查询。启动这段服务面的代码面对一个经典问题：**异步任务里的同步错误如何报告给同步的构造函数**——`TcpListener::bind` 发生在 spawn 出去的 async 任务里，可「端口被占」必须在 `OffloadHost::new` 返回前就变成 `Err`，否则部署者要到第一个 peer 连不上时才发现。
254	
255	解法是 fail-fast 三件套加一条 ready channel：
256	
257	1. **RDMA NIC 非空**（4.2 已见）：没有网卡却开 P2P 是配置矛盾，当场拒绝。
258	2. **`advertise_addr` 必须可解析为 `SocketAddr`**：它在 [src/config.rs:L15-L20](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/config.rs#L15-L20) 的文档里写明「字面 socket 地址——它兼作内嵌传输服务的 bind 地址，所以 hostname 在启动时被拒」，且跨节点使用不得是 `0.0.0.0`/`127.0.0.1`。用一个既能通告又能 bind 的值，免去配置两个字段的口径问题。
259	3. **端口 bind 先行**：serve 任务第一件事就是 bind，成功失败都经 ready channel 回话；`new` 阻塞在 `recv()` 上等回话，把异步世界的结果折算成本次调用的 `Ok`/`Err`。
260	
261	ready channel 用的是 `std::sync::mpsc` 而非 tokio 通道：接收端是同步的 `new()`（此刻我们不在任何 runtime 上下文里），标准库的阻塞 `recv()` 恰好是要的语义，不必动用 `Handle::block_on`。
262	
263	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
264	
265	```text
266	match config.p2p
267	  ├─ None → p2p_shutdown = None（进程只做本机 host 层，不起服务面）
268	  └─ Some(p2p):
269	       ① listen = advertise_addr.parse::<SocketAddr>()?
270	            └─ 解析失败 → Err#3（InvalidArgument）
271	       ② 建 shutdown oneshot（drop 即停机信号）
272	          建 ready mpsc（std 同步通道）
273	       ③ runtime.spawn(serve 任务):
274	            TcpListener::bind(listen).await
275	              ├─ Ok(l)  → ready_tx.send(Ok(()))
276	              │           → TcpListenerStream 包装
277	              │           → P2pTransferService::serve_with_incoming(
278	              │                 engine, incoming, async { shutdown_rx.await })
279	              └─ Err(e) → ready_tx.send(Err("bind …")) → 任务返回（不服务）
280	       ④ ready_rx.recv() 阻塞等回话
281	            ├─ 任务没回话就死   → Err#4（Storage: "P2P serve task died at startup"）
282	            └─ 回话内容是 Err   → Err#5（Storage: bind 失败详情）
283	       ⑤ runtime.spawn(GC 循环)        —— 见 4.4
284	       ⑥ p2p_shutdown = Some(shutdown_tx)
285	```

347	### 4.4 GC 双清扫与 drop 语义
348	
349	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
350	
351	P2P 一旦开起来，本实例的 host 池里会积累两类「别人留下的」状态，它们的共同点是：**合法产生、无人负责清理**。
352	
353	- **过期 transfer lock（传输锁）**：对端 peer 发起单边 RDMA READ 之前，会先在本端给目标块上锁，防止读到一半块被驱逐改写。正常流程是读完解锁；但 peer 若在读取中途崩溃，锁的持有者永远消失，谁也不会来解锁。不清扫的后果：被锁的块无限期钉在 host 池，等效内存泄漏。
354	- **陈旧 in-flight（预取状态）**：本端 query miss 时会发起后台远端拉取（Loading 态，见 u2-l7）。若请求在拉取中途被放弃——请求被 drop，或 executor 的 re-query deadline 触发重查——已完成（或已失败）的拉取任务留下孤儿条目，把拉来的块占在 pinned pool 里。
355	
356	GC 循环每 1 分钟 tick 一次，对这两类垃圾各扫一遍。两类垃圾对应两类故障方向：**前者是对端崩溃在我处留下的锁，后者是本端请求被遗弃后替对端拉来的货**。
357	
358	drop 语义则是宿主的生命周期终局。因为 `OffloadHost` 只以 `Arc` 流通，最后一个 `Arc` 被 drop 时结构体字段按声明顺序销毁（`engine` → `runtime` → `p2p_shutdown`），runtime 的关闭随即带走它上面的一切。文档注释（[src/host.rs:L25-L29](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/host.rs#L25-L29)）逐项写了后果，4.4.3 精读里照录。
359	
360	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
361	
362	GC 循环的节奏与扫描对象：
363	
364	```text
365	每 60s 一次 tick（MissedTickBehavior::Skip：错过了不补发，防追帧风暴）
366	  ├─ gc_expired_transfer_locks()          // 同步调用，返回释放条数
367	  │     释放：TTL 已过的对端传输锁
368	  └─ gc_stale_inflight(5min, 5min).await  // 异步调用，返回 (stale, failed)
369	        释放：年龄超过 5 分钟的预取条目 + 失败远端标记
370	  任何一项 > 0 都打日志（warn / info）
371	```
372	
373	被锁块的实际最长滞留时间是一个区间而不是定值：锁自身带 TTL，GC 每 60 秒巡一次，所以一个被崩溃 peer 遗留的锁最长把块钉到「锁 TTL + 最多一个 GC 周期」，即滞留 \( \in [\text{TTL},\ \text{TTL} + 60\text{s}) \)（TTL 数值定义在 pegaflow-core 内，此处不展开）。
374	
375	drop 语义的因果链：
376	
377	```text
378	最后一个 Arc<OffloadHost> drop
379	  → 结构体字段销毁：engine(Arc) → runtime → p2p_shutdown(oneshot::Sender)
380	  → Runtime 关闭：其上所有任务终止
381	      ├─ 在途 fire-and-forget save 被抛弃        // 可接受：host 层只是缓存
382	      ├─ P2P serving 任务与 GC 循环停止
383	      │    （oneshot Sender 的销毁同样让 shutdown_rx.await 返回——双保险）
384	      └─ 在途 flush_saves_then 屏障被取消
385	           → 其 then 回调不运行、直接 drop       // 见 u2-l8 的屏障语义
386	  → 对端 peer 视角：本实例从 MetaServer 消失/不可达 → 退化为各自本地 prefill
387	```
388	
389	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
390	
391	GC 循环本体在 [src/host.rs:L112-L140](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/host.rs#L112-L140)。注释先声明它「镜像 pegaflow-server 的同名任务」，然后解释双清扫各自防什么：
392	
393	```rust
394	// Background GC, mirroring pegaflow-server's task. Two sweeps:
395	// expired transfer locks (a crashed peer must not pin our
396	// blocks past the lock timeout) and stale prefetch state — an
397	// abandoned remote fetch (request dropped mid-RemoteFetch, or
398	// the executor's re-query deadline fired) leaves an orphaned
399	// entry whose completed task pins its fetched blocks in the
400	// pinned pool until this sweep drops it.
401	```
402	
403	循环骨架（节选）：
404	
405	```rust
406	const STALE_MAX_AGE: std::time::Duration = std::time::Duration::from_mins(5);
407	let mut tick = tokio::time::interval(std::time::Duration::from_mins(1));
408	tick.set_missed_tick_behavior(tokio::time::MissedTickBehavior::Skip);
409	loop {
410	    tick.tick().await;
411	    let expired = gc_engine.gc_expired_transfer_locks();
412	    ...
413	    let (stale, failed) = gc_engine.gc_stale_inflight(STALE_MAX_AGE, STALE_MAX_AGE).await;
414	    ...
415	}
416	```
417	
418	两个可留意的细节：`MissedTickBehavior::Skip` 让被任务拥延误点的 tick 直接跳过而不补发，GC 永远不会为「赶进度」连环扫描；两个常量（1 分钟 tick、5 分钟最大年龄）都是**清垃圾的保守上限**而非正确性参数——扫晚一点只是垃圾多占一会儿内存，不损任何推理正确性。

420	drop 语义的权威表述在 [src/host.rs:L25-L29](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/host.rs#L25-L29) 的结构体文档注释：

422	> Dropping the last handle drops the [`Runtime`], which abandons any in-flight fire-and-forget saves (acceptable — the host tier is a cache) and stops the P2P serving tasks; peers degrade to their own local prefill. In-flight `OffloadEngine::flush_saves_then` barriers are cancelled too, dropping their `then` callbacks unrun.

433	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
434	
435	**练习 1**：GC 的 1 分钟 tick 会不会与 save/load 抢 worker 线程导致推理抖动？
436	
437	**答案**：会占用但影响可忽略。GC 与推理不在同一世界：D2H/H2D 数据搬运走 CUDA 侧，GC 只动 host 内存里的元数据与 pinned pool 条目；且每 60 秒一次的两次调用（一个同步、一个短暂 `await`）在 `runtime_threads` 默认 2 个 worker 上是毫秒级的工作量。真正要紧的是它**必须在某个 runtime 上常驻**——这正是它与 serving 同住宿主 runtime 的原因。

439	**练习 2**：最后一个 `Arc<OffloadHost>` 被 drop 时，恰好有一个 `flush_saves_then` 屏障在等一个在途 save。屏障里排队的 `then` 回调（比如「发出 Finished 事件」）会执行吗？这正确吗？
440	
441	**答案**：不执行——文档明说屏障被取消、`then` 回调 unrun 直接 drop。这是**有意的**正确取舍：宿主消失意味着整个进程的 offload 能力退场，此刻若还去发「KV 已就绪」信号反而是错误信号。代价是该请求的 Finished 事件悬置、客户端侧等不到响应，由上层（HTTP 连接断开/超时）兜底——与「对端退化为本地 prefill」同属一个故障语义家族：宁可显式失败，不可谎报成功。

# 共享宿主 OffloadHost：tokio runtime、PegaEngine 与 P2P 生命周期

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u2-l1）我们读完了配置层：`OffloadConfig` 用 `host()` 方法把「宿主半边」拆成了 crate 私有的 `HostConfig`。本讲就顺着这条线，精读 `host.rs`（全文件仅 157 行），搞清楚 `HostConfig` 最终喂给了谁、发生了什么。学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 解释 OffloadHost 的三个字段（`engine` / `runtime` / `p2p_shutdown`）各自的职责，以及「一个 host 服务任意多个 rank 级引擎」的 DP-rank 共享模型。
2. 说出 `PegaEngine` 为什么必须在 `runtime.enter()` 守卫内构建。
3. 逐一列举 `OffloadHost::new` 返回 `Err` 的全部位置，特别是 P2P 启动路径的三个 fail-fast 校验（RDMA NIC 非空、`advertise_addr` 可解析为 `SocketAddr`、端口 bind 先行）。
4. 描述 1 分钟一次的 GC 双清扫各自回收哪类垃圾、分别对应哪种对端故障。
5. 复述 drop 语义：最后一个句柄 drop 时，runtime、在途 save、P2P 服务与 flush 屏障各自发生什么。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲涉及的 Rust / tokio 概念都不深，但先用两句话把直觉建立起来：

- **tokio runtime（运行时）**：一个自带线程池的任务调度器。`runtime.spawn(async move {...})` 把一个异步任务交给它后台执行；`Builder::new_multi_thread()` 创建带 worker 线程池的运行时，`enable_all()` 打开它的 IO 与定时器驱动。
- **`tokio::spawn` 的上下文要求**：`tokio::spawn` 并非随处可调——它从当前线程的线程局部变量里取「我正处在哪个 runtime 里」。若调用线程不在任何 runtime 上下文中，它会直接 panic。`runtime.enter()` 返回一个守卫（guard），守卫存活期间当前线程被登记为「在该 runtime 内」，spawn 即可正常工作；守卫 drop 时线程脱离上下文。
- **oneshot 与 mpsc channel**：oneshot 是「只能发一次」的通道，常被用作取消信号——发送端被 drop 时，接收端的 `await` 立刻返回，等于一声「停」。`std::sync::mpsc` 是标准库的同步多生产者通道，它的 `recv()` 是阻塞调用，适合在同步代码里等一个异步任务的结果。
- **fail-fast（快速失败）**：把「将来某天静默出错」提前成「启动时大声报错」。配置错误的代价随发现时间指数增长，这是本讲 P2P 启动路径反复出现的主题。
- **TTL 与 GC**：TTL（time-to-live）是「这条记录最多活多久」的期限；GC（garbage collection）在这里指周期性巡检并清掉过期记录的循环。分布式系统里，锁和缓存条目必须有 TTL 兜底，因为持有它们的对端可能随时崩溃、永远不再回来。

另外请回忆 u2-l1 的结论：`HostConfig` 是 crate 私有结构体，只含宿主字段（pinned 池容量、hugepages、线程数、p2p）；身份字段（`instance_id` / `namespace` / `device_id`）留在 `OffloadConfig` 里给注册用。本讲要讲的，就是 `HostConfig` 的归宿。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 | 本讲的用法 |
|------|------|-----------|
| [src/host.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/host.rs) | `OffloadHost` 的全部实现：runtime、PegaEngine、P2P serving、GC、drop | 本讲核心，逐段精读 |
| [src/config.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/config.rs) | `P2pConfig` / `HostConfig` 定义与 `host()` 拆分 | 引用 P2P 三字段的约束说明 |
| [src/engine.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs) | `OffloadEngine` 的两条构造入口 | 只看 `new`（私有 host）与 `with_arenas_on`（共享 host）如何触碰 OffloadHost，注册细节留给下一讲 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 OffloadHost：结构体与 DP-rank 共享模型

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`OffloadEngine`（下一讲的主角）是「一个 rank 的 GPU KV 缓存与 pegaflow 深层之间的桥」。那么 runtime、pinned pool、P2P 服务这些**进程级**资源为什么要跟着每个引擎走一遍？——不需要。`OffloadHost` 就是把这些进程级资源抽出来单独持有：

- 一个 `PegaEngine`：pegaflow 的引擎实例，CPU pinned 池的实际所有者；
- 一个多线程 tokio `Runtime`：驱动 pegaflow 所有异步操作（save / query / load / P2P serving / GC）的调度器；
- 一个可选的 `p2p_shutdown` oneshot 发送端：drop 时叫停 P2P 服务任务。

「共享」的含义见结构体文档注释里的 **DP-rank 共享模型**：数据并行（DP）下多个 rank 通常持有相同的模型权重副本，各自处理不同请求。每个 rank 各建一个 `OffloadEngine`、注册成**自己的** pegaflow instance（有自己的 `instance_id` 和 GPU arena），但它们可以搭在**同一个** `OffloadHost` 上——所有块都落进同一个 host 池，按 `(namespace, hash)` 寻址。只要 namespace 相同，任何 rank 都能恢复任何 rank 存过的块：rank 0 prefill 出来的前缀，rank 1 接到同前缀的新请求时直接命中。

这个「共享」为什么是安全的？文档注释给了一个精确的论证：调用方只应在「KV 跨 instance 可互换」时共享 namespace。对复制权重的 DP rank，这成立的容忍度与复用本 rank 自己的前缀缓存相同——不同 batch 形状下 FP 归约顺序不同会导致字节级差异，但这就像「同一段前缀本地重算两次也会逐字节不同」一样，是浮点推理的固有属性，不是新的风险。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```text
                 ┌───────────────────────────────┐
                 │      一个 OffloadHost          │
                 │  PegaEngine + Runtime (+P2P)   │
                 └──────────────┬────────────────┘
                                │ host 池按 (namespace, hash) 寻址
          ┌─────────────────────┼─────────────────────┐
          │                     │                     │
   OffloadEngine(rank0)   OffloadEngine(rank1)   OffloadEngine(rank2)
   instance_id = "r0"     instance_id = "r1"     instance_id = "r2"
   namespace  = "qwen3"   namespace  = "qwen3"   namespace  = "qwen3"
   各自的 GPU arena        各自的 GPU arena        各自的 GPU arena
```

- 引擎是「rank 级」的：一个 rank 的注册（GPU 布局、layer 名、device）只描述自己那块卡。
- 宿主是「进程级」的：pinned 池、runtime、对外服务只有一份。
- 命中判定与 instance 无关，只看 `(namespace, hash)`——这正是 u1-l2 讲过的内容寻址在共享模型里的落点。

### 4.2 宿主构造：多线程 runtime 与 enter() 守卫内的 PegaEngine

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`OffloadHost::new` 的前半段做两件事：建 runtime、建 PegaEngine。第二件事有一个不显眼但致命的时序要求——**PegaEngine 必须在 runtime.enter() 守卫内构建**。

原因：pegaflow 的 `MetaServerClient`（P2P 模式下负责向 MetaServer 注册块哈希的客户端）在**构造时**就用 `tokio::spawn` 启动后台注册循环。而 `tokio::spawn` 只在「当前线程处于某个 runtime 上下文」时才能调用。`OffloadHost::new` 是一个普通同步函数，跑在调用方的线程上——此刻 runtime 刚建好，但这个线程并没有「进入」它。若直接构造 PegaEngine，`MetaServerClient` 内部的 `tokio::spawn` 会 panic（找不到当前 runtime）。`runtime.enter()` 的守卫把这个线程临时登记进 runtime，让构造期间的 spawn 全部落到**我们自己的** runtime 上。

注意一个容易混淆的点：**不开 P2P 也需要 enter()**。守卫包住的是 `PegaEngine::new_with_config` 整体，与 `config.p2p` 是否为 `Some` 无关——源码注释只以 MetaServerClient 为例说明动机，但守卫对两条路径统一生效，这也让代码无需为 P2P 与非 P2P 维护两套构建方式。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
OffloadHost::new(HostConfig)
  │
  ├─ 1. Builder::new_multi_thread()
  │       .worker_threads( max(runtime_threads, 1) )   // 0 会被钳到 1
  │       .enable_all()                                 // IO + 定时器驱动
  │       .build()
  │       └─ 失败 → Err#1（EngineError::Storage）
  │
  ├─ 2. StorageConfig::default()
  │       若 config.p2p = Some(p2p):
  │         ├─ rdma_nics 为空 → Err#2（EngineError::InvalidArgument）
  │         └─ 注入 rdma_nic_names / metaserver_addr / advertise_addr
  │
  └─ 3. { let _guard = runtime.enter();
             PegaEngine::new_with_config(pinned_pool_bytes,
                                         use_hugepages,
                                         storage_config)?   // Err 原样上抛
         }  // 守卫在此 drop，线程脱离 runtime 上下文
```

线程数的默认值来自配置层：[src/config.rs:L41-L44](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/config.rs#L41-L44) 的注释说「两个就够了：save 是 fire-and-forget，query 只是一次短暂的内存缓存查找」。但开了 P2P 后这个 runtime 还要同时承载 gRPC serving 与 GC 循环（4.3 / 4.4），所以它是多线程 runtime 而非单线程的 `new_current_thread`。

### 4.3 P2P serving 启动路径：三个 fail-fast 与 ready channel

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

P2P 模式（`config.p2p = Some`）意味着本实例加入跨实例共享网格：把存的块哈希注册到 MetaServer、在 `advertise_addr` 上服务对端的 RDMA 握手与块查询。启动这段服务面的代码面对一个经典问题：**异步任务里的同步错误如何报告给同步的构造函数**——`TcpListener::bind` 发生在 spawn 出去的 async 任务里，可「端口被占」必须在 `OffloadHost::new` 返回前就变成 `Err`，否则部署者要到第一个 peer 连不上时才发现。

解法是 fail-fast 三件套加一条 ready channel：

1. **RDMA NIC 非空**（4.2 已见）：没有网卡却开 P2P 是配置矛盾，当场拒绝。
2. **`advertise_addr` 必须可解析为 `SocketAddr`**：它在 [src/config.rs:L15-L20](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/config.rs#L15-L20) 的文档里写明「字面 socket 地址——它兼作内嵌传输服务的 bind 地址，所以 hostname 在启动时被拒」，且跨节点使用不得是 `0.0.0.0`/`127.0.0.1`。用一个既能通告又能 bind 的值，免去配置两个字段的口径问题。
3. **端口 bind 先行**：serve 任务第一件事就是 bind，成功失败都经 ready channel 回话；`new` 阻塞在 `recv()` 上等回话，把异步世界的结果折算成本次调用的 `Ok`/`Err`。

ready channel 用的是 `std::sync::mpsc` 而非 tokio 通道：接收端是同步的 `new()`（此刻我们不在任何 runtime 上下文里），标准库的阻塞 `recv()` 恰好是要的语义，不必动用 `Handle::block_on`。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```text
match config.p2p
  ├─ None → p2p_shutdown = None（进程只做本机 host 层，不起服务面）
  └─ Some(p2p):
       ① listen = advertise_addr.parse::<SocketAddr>()?
            └─ 解析失败 → Err#3（InvalidArgument）
       ② 建 shutdown oneshot（drop 即停机信号）
          建 ready mpsc（std 同步通道）
       ③ runtime.spawn(serve 任务):
            TcpListener::bind(listen).await
              ├─ Ok(l)  → ready_tx.send(Ok(()))
              │           → TcpListenerStream 包装
              │           → P2pTransferService::serve_with_incoming(
              │                 engine, incoming, async { shutdown_rx.await })
              └─ Err(e) → ready_tx.send(Err("bind …")) → 任务返回（不服务）
       ④ ready_rx.recv() 阻塞等回话
            ├─ 任务没回话就死   → Err#4（Storage: "P2P serve task died at startup"）
            └─ 回话内容是 Err   → Err#5（Storage: bind 失败详情）
       ⑤ runtime.spawn(GC 循环)        —— 见 4.4
       ⑥ p2p_shutdown = Some(shutdown_tx)
```

`serve_with_incoming` 的第三个参数是 shutdown future（`shutdown_rx.await`）：它完成时 serving 优雅收尾。而 oneshot 的特性保证了**发送端无论主动发送还是被 drop，接收端的 `await` 都会返回**——所以「drop 宿主」天然成为「停服务」。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

### 4.4 GC 双清扫与 drop 语义

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

P2P 一旦开起来，本实例的 host 池里会积累两类「别人留下的」状态，它们的共同点是：**合法产生、无人负责清理**。

- **过期 transfer lock（传输锁）**：对端 peer 发起单边 RDMA READ 之前，会先在本端给目标块上锁，防止读到一半块被驱逐改写。正常流程是读完解锁；但 peer 若在读取中途崩溃，锁的持有者永远消失，谁也不会来解锁。不清扫的后果：被锁的块无限期钉在 host 池，等效内存泄漏。
- **陈旧 in-flight（预取状态）**：本端 query miss 时会发起后台远端拉取（Loading 态，见 u2-l7）。若请求在拉取中途被放弃——请求被 drop，或 executor 的 re-query deadline 触发重查——已完成（或已失败）的拉取任务留下孤儿条目，把拉来的块占在 pinned pool 里。

GC 循环每 1 分钟 tick 一次，对这两类垃圾各扫一遍。两类垃圾对应两类故障方向：**前者是对端崩溃在我处留下的锁，后者是本端请求被遗弃后替对端拉来的货**。

drop 语义则是宿主的生命周期终局。因为 `OffloadHost` 只以 `Arc` 流通，最后一个 `Arc` 被 drop 时结构体字段按声明顺序销毁（`engine` → `runtime` → `p2p_shutdown`），runtime 的关闭随即带走它上面的一切。文档注释（[src/host.rs:L25-L29](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/host.rs#L25-L29)）逐项写了后果，4.4.3 精读里照录。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

GC 循环的节奏与扫描对象：

```text
每 60s 一次 tick（MissedTickBehavior::Skip：错过了不补发，防追帧风暴）
  ├─ gc_expired_transfer_locks()          // 同步调用，返回释放条数
  │     释放：TTL 已过的对端传输锁
  └─ gc_stale_inflight(5min, 5min).await  // 异步调用，返回 (stale, failed)
        释放：年龄超过 5 分钟的预取条目 + 失败远端标记
  任何一项 > 0 都打日志（warn / info）
```

被锁块的实际最长滞留时间是一个区间而不是定值：锁自身带 TTL，GC 每 60 秒巡一次，所以一个被崩溃 peer 遗留的锁最长把块钉到「锁 TTL + 最多一个 GC 周期」，即滞留 \( \in [\text{TTL},\ \text{TTL} + 60\text{s}) \)（TTL 数值定义在 pegaflow-core 内，此处不展开）。

drop 语义的因果链：

```text
最后一个 Arc<OffloadHost> drop
  → 结构体字段销毁：engine(Arc) → runtime → p2p_shutdown(oneshot::Sender)
  → Runtime 关闭：其上所有任务终止
      ├─ 在途 fire-and-forget save 被抛弃        // 可接受：host 层只是缓存
      ├─ P2P serving 任务与 GC 循环停止
      │    （oneshot Sender 的销毁同样让 shutdown_rx.await 返回——双保险）
      └─ 在途 flush_saves_then 屏障被取消
           → 其 then 回调不运行、直接 drop       // 见 u2-l8 的屏障语义
  → 对端 peer 视角：本实例从 MetaServer 消失/不可达 → 退化为各自本地 prefill
```

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

GC 循环本体在 [src/host.rs:L112-L140](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/host.rs#L112-L140)。注释先声明它「镜像 pegaflow-server 的同名任务」，然后解释双清扫各自防什么：

```rust
// Background GC, mirroring pegaflow-server's task. Two sweeps:
// expired transfer locks (a crashed peer must not pin our
// blocks past the lock timeout) and stale prefetch state — an
// abandoned remote fetch (request dropped mid-RemoteFetch, or
// the executor's re-query deadline fired) leaves an orphaned
// entry whose completed task pins its fetched blocks in the
// pinned pool until this sweep drops it.
```

循环骨架（节选）：

```rust
const STALE_MAX_AGE: std::time::Duration = std::time::Duration::from_mins(5);
let mut tick = tokio::time::interval(std::time::Duration::from_mins(1));
tick.set_missed_tick_behavior(tokio::time::MissedTickBehavior::Skip);
loop {
    tick.tick().await;
    let expired = gc_engine.gc_expired_transfer_locks();
    ...
    let (stale, failed) = gc_engine.gc_stale_inflight(STALE_MAX_AGE, STALE_MAX_AGE).await;
    ...
}
```

两个可留意的细节：`MissedTickBehavior::Skip` 让被任务拥延误点的 tick 直接跳过而不补发，GC 永远不会为「赶进度」连环扫描；两个常量（1 分钟 tick、5 分钟最大年龄）都是**清垃圾的保守上限**而非正确性参数——扫晚一点只是垃圾多占一会儿内存，不损任何推理正确性。

drop 语义的权威表述在 [src/host.rs:L25-L29](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/host.rs#L25-L29) 的结构体文档注释：

> Dropping the last handle drops the [`Runtime`], which abandons any in-flight fire-and-forget saves (acceptable — the host tier is a cache) and stops the P2P serving tasks; peers degrade to their own local prefill. In-flight `OffloadEngine::flush_saves_then` barriers are cancelled too, dropping their `then` callbacks unrun.

每一项都承接前面讲义立过的原则：丢 save 只损命中机会（u1-l2 的「save 尽力而为」红线）；对端退化到本地重算是 P/D 故障语义的标准出口（u3-l2 展开）；屏障取消则意味着**正在 withhold 的 Finished 事件就此悬置**——调用方必须把「宿主可能整体消失」纳入容错考量。

## 6. 本讲小结

- **OffloadHost 是进程级资源的三合一容器**：一个 `PegaEngine`（host 池真正的主人）、一个多线程 tokio `Runtime`、一个可选的 P2P 停机信号；引擎（rank 级）可搭多个，宿主只有一份，块按 `(namespace, hash)` 跨引擎共享——这就是 DP-rank 共享模型。
- **可见性即架构**：类型公开、`new` 私有、`HostConfig` crate 私有，三者合力保证宿主只能经 `OffloadEngine` 的两条构造入口（`new` 私有 / `with_arenas_on` 共享）诞生。
- **enter() 守卫是硬约束**：PegaEngine 构造内部有 `tokio::spawn`（MetaServerClient 注册循环），必须让调用线程处在 runtime 上下文，否则 panic。
- **P2P 启动路径五个 Err 点、三道 fail-fast**：NIC 非空、地址必须是字面 `SocketAddr`（兼作 bind 地址）、端口 bind 先行 + ready channel 回话——坏配置永远活不过构造函数。
- **GC 双清扫按责任人分两类**：对端崩溃遗留的传输锁（TTL 兜底）与本端被弃请求的孤儿预取条目（5 分钟年龄兜底），1 分钟一拍、误点跳过不补发。
- **drop 是有意的损失设计**：最后一个句柄消失 → runtime 关闭 → 在途 save 抛弃（缓存语义）、P2P 停服（对端退化本地 prefill）、flush 屏障取消（then 回调 unrun）——宁可显式失败，不可谎报就绪。

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.
